Details is the card, big: same frame, title and colors (pink
dashes: under siege). Its station and moons are part of it, and open

Everything the small card can't hold: the building line, people,
What waits for contracts is drawn in its place and switched off,
A profile is a pilot's card. Simple now, with room for achievements
